biw_news.title: Leapmotor Introduces LEAP 5.0 Architecture and CTC 3.0 Cell-to-Chassis Tech
biw_news.summary: Leapmotor unveiled its LEAP 5.0 vehicle architecture designed to optimize cabin space along with a Cell-to-Chassis (CTC 3.0) battery integration system. The structural innovation integrates high and low voltage functionality to eliminate traditional 12V battery dependencies.

biw_news.title: Volkswagen Group Delays Next-Gen Scalable Systems Platform (SSP)
biw_news.summary: Software and platform development bottlenecks have forced Volkswagen to push the rollout of its unified SSP EV architecture to 2029. The delay impacts core structural and vehicle program launches across Audi and VW brands.

biw_news.title: Aston Martin DB12 S Achieves 50kg Mass Reduction Through Structural Optimization
biw_news.summary: The performance-focused Aston Martin DB12 S variant cuts up to 50kg of kerb weight through targeted structural lightweighting and chassis tuning. Power is also increased alongside improved dynamic stiffness.

biw_news.title: Audi Commences Series Production of Compact A2 e-tron in Ingolstadt
biw_news.summary: Audi has officially started body assembly and manufacturing of the all-electric A2 e-tron at its main plant in Ingolstadt. Production processes focus on maximum assembly efficiency and streamlined structural manufacturing.

biw_news.title: Volkswagen Unveils Ultra-Efficient Lightweight Concept Derived from XL1 Design
biw_news.summary: Volkswagen has revealed the Mission Efficiency concept, drawing engineering inspiration from the ultra-lightweight XL1 monocoque principles. The EV concept explores extreme aerodynamic profiling paired with lightweight body structures.

biw_news.title: Ford Expands Kentucky Assembly Operations with New Manufacturing Capital Investment
biw_news.summary: Ford has committed new funding toward its Kentucky Truck Plant to upgrade manufacturing infrastructure and assembly line flexibility. The investment supports ongoing body assembly and production scaling for high-margin truck platforms.
